title: Luna's UpdateMize o7!

body:
# 🌙 Luna's UpdateMize o7 🌙
**The ⚡ recreation ⚡ NeoForge 26.1.2 Mod that adds the Minecraft Live 2026.2 features early! (Poplar, Wool Stairs and Slabs, Abandoned Camp)**

Hello everyone! I am Sushi, or Luna! :3

## [▶️ Official Video (Click Me!) ▶️](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-lCmqDEG0OM)
 
## 🌟 Welcome to the 7th installment of the UpdateMize series! 🌟
Today I present to you - a mod that recreates the Minecraft Live 2026.2 features teased at TwitchCon - the Dappled Forest, Poplar Wood Set, Wool Stairs and Slabs, and the Abandoned Camp!

 
## 🎥 Minecraft Live recap! 🎥
Minecraft Live teased some awesome things! You can now find the Dappled Forest biome, with its new Poplar Trees! Those trees have 3 different types of leaves - yellow, orange, and red! There's also a whole new wood set, that looks strikingly similar to Pale Oak, but darker! In fact, they did showcase the contrast between the two, and personally I see great potential for building with this!

On the topic of building, we can't forget about the brand new wool stairs and slabs! You can now craft stairs and slabs out of all 16 colors of wool, and use them for all sorts of colored buildings! They are also used in the new Abandoned Camp structure, which is a run-down tent! We can now finally make more accurate tents inside of Minecraft!

Once again, I have recreated all the features inside of the game early - and this time, I got to see them live at TwitchCon! But under no circumstance am I ending the series - so here comes UpdateMize o7!
 
## 🔥 Features of UpdateMize o7 🔥

- The Dappled Forest Biome!
- Poplar Trees, with yellow, orange, and red Poplar Leaves!
- Poplar Logs, Planks, Stairs, Slabs, Doors, and Trapdoors!
- Poplar Boat, Poplar Boat with Chest, Poplar Signs, Poplar Hanging Signs!
- Poplar Fence, Fence Gate, Pressure Plate and Button!
- Red Shrubs and Poplar Saplings!
- Wool Stairs and Slabs, of all 16 colors of wool!
- Abandoned Camp structure, that can be found in the Dappled Forest!

 
## ❇️ [NEW!] Creative Tab! ❇️

As of this UpdateMize, you can now find every new addition in a new Creative tab! (the items are still available in the Vanilla tabs too!)

 
## ✨ Mod Information! ✨

You can see info about the mod's mechanics in-game by pressing the U key (this can be configured)! This info is below as well:

New Stuff:

- Added Dappled Forest Biome!
- Added Poplar trees, with yellow, orange, and red leaf variants!
- Added Poplar planks, stairs, slabs, stripped wood, doors, and trapdoors!
- Added Poplar signs, hanging signs, boats, and boats with chest!
- Added Abandoned Camp structure, with sweet loot inside!
- Added Wool Stairs and Slabs, of all 16 colors!
- Added Poplar Sapling and Red Shrub!
- All of the above are 100% accessible in Survival Mode!

Some notes:

- The Poplar Shelf has not been implemented.
- The loot inside the Abandoned Camp has not been revealed. The loot you'll find is just a concept!

- Do NOT upload edited versions of this mod to any platform! Only link to my mod through this page or a review video that agrees with the policies above.
- DO NOT REUPLOAD THIS MOD! I do not allow it - asking me will not change anything. I do not allow reuploads of this mod whatsoever. If you wish to share it, just share this page!
